metadata.provenance_compliance: Part 4 & Part 5 Data Engineer Provenance Specification

status_definitions.DOCUMENTED: External source terms, licensing, and extracted parameters verified and cited.
status_definitions.AVAILABLE: Raw data file located on disk in project or data/external/ directory.
status_definitions.INGESTED: Local raw external file loaded and parsed by ingestion pipeline.
status_definitions.PROCESSED: Dataset fully cleaned, normalized, and statistical priors compiled.
status_definitions.NOT_AVAILABLE: Optional source was not present on disk; pipeline proceeds cleanly.
status_definitions.FAILED: File was present but corrupted or failed validation.

upstream_sources.notes: Primary reference seed cohort providing clinical, demographic, and laboratory distributions.
Pathology biopsy metadata and multi-modal split indicators.
Longitudinal clinical text notes and triage urgency classifications.

external_sources.source_name: The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) Pan-Cancer Atlas
external_sources.access_method: NCI GDC API / Authenticated DUA Workflow
external_sources.license_or_DUA: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC-BY 4.0) / NIH Open Access
extracted_statistics: Age distribution parameters (mean, std, quartiles) per tumor type
external_sources.dua_compliance_notes: Automated download requires dbGaP authorization for controlled tier. Curated published summary statistics are utilized for population priors.

external_sources.access_method: cBioPortal API / Sage Synapse DUA Workflow
external_sources.license_or_DUA: AACR Project GENIE Data Use Agreement (Open Academic / Research Access)
external_sources.publication: AACR Project GENIE Consortium. Cancer Discov. 2017;7(8):818-831.
extracted_statistics: Prevalence of actionable driver alterations (EGFR, KRAS, BRAF, ALK, PIK3CA, TP53, BRCA1/2)
Pairwise log-odds and mutual exclusivity ratios
Variant allele frequency (VAF) distributions across primary and metastatic sites
external_sources.dua_compliance_notes: Bulk database redistribution requires signed DUA. Curated published frequency and co-occurrence tables are implemented.

external_sources.source_name: Catalogue Of Somatic Mutations In Cancer (COSMIC)
external_sources.dataset_name: Cancer Mutation Database & Drug Resistance Mutations
external_sources.publication: Tate JG, et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2019;47(D1):D941-D947.
extracted_statistics: Secondary resistance hotspot variants (e.g., EGFR T790M, C797S; KRAS G12C bypass mechanisms)
Frequency of tertiary compound resistance combinations
Clonal evolution dynamics under targeted inhibitor pressure
external_sources.dua_compliance_notes: Direct bulk FTP download requires institutional login. Curated literature resistance kinetics are implemented.

external_sources.publication: Landrum MJ, et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2020;48(D1):D835-D844.
extracted_statistics: Pathogenicity categorization criteria (Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, VUS, Conflicting)
Evidence tier mapping for genomic safety checking
